features.catalog_choice: yes (search, breadcrumb rows, a custom image row)
features.default_selection: branding default_image, then the catalog's, else none: you must pick
features.staged_fisherman: yes (staged, SHA256 checked on the host)
features.connectivity_check: blocks (network page, skipped when this computer can copy its own system; registry of the image first; Network settings button)
features.filesystem_choice: the image's list, else xfs, ext4 or btrfs
features.locale_pages: language, keyboard (XKB layout) and time zone pages; a pick changes the live session and the recipe; listed on confirm; checked by fisherman validate
features.cancel_install: Cancel button, asks first; cancelled page
features.translatable: one tr() shim and a lint; template `i18n/template.json`; ships `i18n/fr.json`, loaded for the locale; catalogs kept current by a check (#300)
features.source_check: confirm page, Selected image section; a blocked source holds Install
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm page; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a caption under the bar; the bar is indeterminate until the first step; the cancel question says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.log_after_failure: log in page; the failure page says whether the disk was changed, and when the cleanup failed or timed out
